mapper.select: SELECT dr.id, dr.user_id AS userId, dr.pet_id AS petId, dr.affected_area AS affectedArea, dr.symptoms_json AS symptomsJson, dr.image_url AS imageUrl, dr.description, dr.risk_level AS riskLevel, dr.risk_label AS riskLabel, dr.vision_result_json AS diseasesJson, dr.rag_report AS reportContent, dr.created_at AS createdAt FROM diagnosis_records dr JOIN pets p ON p.id = dr.pet_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE dr.pet_id = #{petId} AND u.email = #{email} AND dr.user_id = u.id ORDER BY dr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagnosis_records dr JOIN pets p ON p.id = dr.pet_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE dr.pet_id = #{petId} AND u.email = #{email} AND dr.user_id = u.id
